meta.title: KSI collector registry (Layer 1: deterministic read-only checks)
meta.boundary: Collectors are read-only by design and produce facts, never statuses. A status changes only through deterministic checks plus human sign-off; generative output is never deterministic telemetry (FedRAMP definitions).

checks.description: AWS Config custom rule (backed by AWS Lambda) that evaluates whether the training-records object in Amazon S3 exists, is current within the defined review interval, and covers each required audience; reports COMPLIANT or NON_COMPLIANT.

outcome_metric.description: Fraction of evaluations reporting COMPLIANT: the reviewed artifact exists AND is current within the defined review interval. A stale or missing artifact evaluates NON_COMPLIANT and scores 0, not passing.

checks.description: Amazon EventBridge scheduled AWS Lambda check that compares completion records to the AWS IAM Identity Center workforce roster, emits an Amazon CloudWatch metric for coverage percentage and staleness, and raises an AWS Security Hub finding when coverage drops below the threshold.

checks.description: AWS Config confirms AWS CodePipeline stages and required approval and test gates are present in the pipeline definition.

AWS CodePipeline and AWS CodeBuild run automated tests and Amazon Inspector scans on each change; results and pass or fail gate outcomes are emitted to Amazon CloudWatch and AWS Security Hub, proving validation runs on every deployment.
AWS Config managed rules `iam-policy-no-statements-with-admin-access` and `ecs-task-definition-user-for-host-mode-check` confirm privileges match the defined baseline.
AWS CloudTrail with Amazon EventBridge and IAM Access Analyzer surface use of privileges outside the defined set, raising an AWS Security Hub finding.
AWS Config detects configuration drift against the AWS CloudFormation baseline and reports NON_COMPLIANT resources.
AWS Config automatic remediation via AWS Systems Manager Automation returns drifted resources to the intended state and records the correction in AWS Security Hub.
AWS Config conformance pack evaluates resource configurations against the codified best-practice ruleset.
AWS Security Hub continuously scores resources against the AWS Foundational Security Best Practices and CIS standards and reports deviations as findings.

AWS Config managed rules such as `restricted-ssh`, `s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited`, `vpc-sg-open-only-to-authorized-ports`, and `alb-http-to-https-redirection-check` confirm the surface is constrained.
Amazon GuardDuty detects lateral movement, reconnaissance, and unexpected connections at runtime and raises AWS Security Hub findings.
AWS Config managed rules `elb-cross-zone-load-balancing-enabled` and `rds-multi-az-support` confirm multi-Availability-Zone configuration.
Amazon CloudWatch alarms on Application Load Balancer health and Amazon Route 53 health checks demonstrate failover and availability behavior at runtime, surfaced in AWS Security Hub.
AWS Config managed rules `vpc-default-security-group-closed`, `vpc-sg-open-only-to-authorized-ports`, and `restricted-common-ports` confirm traffic restrictions.
Amazon VPC Flow Logs analyzed through Amazon CloudWatch Logs and Amazon GuardDuty reveal traffic that violates the intended flow and raise AWS Security Hub findings.
AWS Config confirms AWS WAF web access control lists and rate-based rules are associated with the Application Load Balancer and Amazon CloudFront distributions.
AWS WAF and AWS Shield metrics in Amazon CloudWatch show blocked and rate-limited requests, and AWS Security Hub records anomalies, demonstrating the protections work.
AWS Config managed rules for security group and network access control list posture confirm logical segmentation is in place.
Amazon VPC Flow Logs plus Amazon GuardDuty validate that traffic follows the intended logical paths and flag deviations to AWS Security Hub.

AWS Config managed rules `iam-user-no-policies-check`, `access-keys-rotated`, and `iam-user-unused-credentials-check` confirm account and privilege state, and a custom rule confirms AWS IAM Identity Center SCIM provisioning is enabled.

AWS CloudTrail plus Amazon EventBridge detect account create, modify, and disable events and IAM Access Analyzer unused-access findings, raising AWS Security Hub findings that show lifecycle automation operating.
AWS Config managed rules `iam-password-policy` and `mfa-enabled-for-iam-console-access` (and `root-account-mfa-enabled`) confirm MFA and password strength are enforced.

AWS CloudTrail records authentication events in AWS IAM Identity Center; an Amazon EventBridge rule raises an AWS Security Hub finding on any non-MFA or password-only sign-in, showing phishing-resistant methods are in force.
AWS Config managed rules `iam-policy-no-statements-with-admin-access` and `iam-policy-no-statements-with-full-access` confirm policies avoid broad grants.
IAM Access Analyzer continuously identifies unused permissions, roles, and external access and raises AWS Security Hub findings, demonstrating privilege is actively pruned.
AWS Config confirms IAM roles and AWS IAM Identity Center permission sets set short maximum session durations and that no long-lived access keys exist for privileged principals.

AWS CloudTrail plus Amazon EventBridge validate that elevated sessions are short-lived and tied to approvals, raising an AWS Security Hub finding when standing or long-duration privileged sessions appear.
AWS Config managed rules `access-keys-rotated`, `iam-user-no-policies-check`, and `secretsmanager-rotation-enabled-check` confirm non-user credentials are role-based or rotated.

AWS CloudTrail plus Amazon EventBridge detect use of static access keys or unrotated secrets by service principals and raise an AWS Security Hub finding, showing secure non-user authentication is enforced.
AWS Config confirms the Amazon EventBridge rules, AWS Lambda containment functions, and Amazon GuardDuty are enabled and wired to identity findings.

Amazon GuardDuty raises an identity finding, and the Amazon EventBridge and AWS Lambda automation disables or secures the account and records the action in AWS Security Hub and AWS CloudTrail, proving the response works end to end.
AWS Config custom rule (AWS Lambda backed) confirms an after action report object exists in Amazon S3 for each closed incident within the required interval.

AWS CloudTrail plus Amazon EventBridge confirm rotation events occur on schedule and raise an AWS Security Hub finding on a rotation failure or a stale secret, validating automation works.
AWS Config conformance pack evaluates resources against the security baseline and reports gaps.
AWS Security Hub security-standard scores trended in Amazon CloudWatch show improvements over time, and a scheduled AWS Lambda raises a finding when scores regress, validating continuous improvement.

AWS Config confirms Amazon S3 lifecycle policies, Amazon DynamoDB time to live, and backup retention settings are configured to the defined retention.
Amazon EventBridge scheduled AWS Lambda verifies expired data is removed on schedule, emits an Amazon CloudWatch metric, and raises an AWS Security Hub finding on retention violations.
AWS Config managed rules `s3-bucket-server-side-encryption-enabled`, `encrypted-volumes`, `rds-storage-encrypted`, and `s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only` confirm encryption at rest and in transit.
AWS CloudTrail plus Amazon EventBridge detect unencrypted resource creation or non-TLS access attempts and raise an AWS Security Hub finding, validating encryption is enforced.
AWS Config managed rules for TLS enforcement (for example `alb-http-to-https-redirection-check` and `elb-tls-https-listeners-only`) confirm communications are encrypted and validated.
AWS CloudTrail plus Amazon EventBridge detect non-TLS or unauthenticated communication attempts and raise an AWS Security Hub finding, validating communications integrity.
AWS Config confirms image signing, immutable tags on Amazon ECR, and AWS CloudTrail log file validation are enabled.
AWS CodePipeline signature verification at deployment fails and raises an AWS Security Hub finding when an artifact fails its integrity check, validating integrity enforcement.
